task_completion.description: Agent navigates to https://books.toscrape.com/ to begin the audit.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser address bar shows 'books.toscrape.com' and the page content (books, categories) is visible.

task_completion.description: Agent performs an audit or crawl of the site to identify title and description issues.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show an SEO tool, script, or browser inspection identifying multiple pages and their metadata status.

task_completion.description: Agent exports title issue data to a CSV file in the specified directory with 'title' in the name.
task_completion.visual_evidence: File manager or terminal shows a file like 'title_issues.csv' in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/.

task_completion.description: Agent exports meta description issue data to a CSV file in the specified directory with 'description' in the name.
task_completion.visual_evidence: File manager or terminal shows a file like 'description_audit.csv' in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the summary report at the specified path with the required metrics and recommendation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text editor or 'cat' command shows ~/Documents/SEO/reports/onpage_audit_report.txt containing a page count, missing description count, and an SEO recommendation.

integrity.description: Agent interacted with the website rather than hallucinating data.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser rendering the actual 'Books to Scrape' site and not just a blank page or a different domain.

integrity.description: Agent used the specific directory structure requested rather than default folders.
integrity.visual_evidence: File paths in screenshots explicitly show the 'SEO/exports' and 'SEO/reports' subdirectories.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply create empty files to pass checks.
integrity.visual_evidence: CSV files or the report shown in screenshots contain actual data (e.g., book titles or specific counts) derived from the site.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target website is https://books.toscrape.com/. It contains 1000 books across 50 pages. The site is a sandbox and intentionally lacks meta descriptions on many pages. The agent must save CSVs to /home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/ and the report to /home/ga/Documents/SEO/reports/onpage_audit_report.txt. The report must include a total page count (approx 50 or 1000 depending on if they count index pages or product pages), a count of missing descriptions, and one recommendation.
